connector.name: CoreWise
connector.registryDescription: Extract structured insights from videos, podcasts, articles, and PDFs with multi-model AI
connector.summary: Hosted at corewise.video over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ryanportfolio account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: CoreWise API key as a Bearer token, e.g. 'Bearer cw_live_...'. Create one at https://corewise.video/profile under 'API & MCP Keys'. Optional: public library search works without a key; extract_url requires one.
